# tplink Provider

Manage TP-Link home routers running the new-generation (SG-hardened) web UI, such as the Archer AX23 v2 on firmware 1.1.2.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    tplink = {
      source = "registry.opentofu.org/repparw/tplink"
    }
  }
}

variable "router_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

provider "tplink" {
  host     = "http://192.168.0.1"
  password = var.router_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Router base address, e.g. `http://192.168.0.1`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Admin password. Prefer an environment variable or a secret store; never commit it.

### Optional

- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Per-request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.
- `tls_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS verification (the router ships a self-signed certificate).
- `username` (String) Admin username. Defaults to `admin`.
